messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — CI on main turned red after the toolchain image roll from yesterday. CMake Linux builds are failing at link time with duplicate-symbols when LTO is enabled. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3421

ci-bot: Build 3421 — linux-cmake — FAILED (link error) — see logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3421/logs

sam: Do we know which flag turned on LTO? Was it in the image or in our CMake presets?

nina: It's in the toolchain image now — the base image sets CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=ON and adds -flto to CXXFLAGS. Locally I can sometimes reproduce but CI consistently fails for a few targets. Sample linker error:```
/opt/toolchain/bin/ld: duplicate symbol _ZN6worker10ProcessEv in libworker.a(worker.o) and libutils.a(utils.o)
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

alex: Can you paste the exact failing target(s) and the job id? I'll start a bisect on the image if we have a digest range.

nina: Failing targets: //src/tools/worker:worker_test and //third_party/foo:foo_test. Job 3421. Repro commands I used locally:```
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace gcr.io/redwood/toolchain:2026-03-10 /bin/bash -c "cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=ON && cmake --build build --target worker_test"
```

sam: Short-term mitigation: we can force-disable LTO for CI by adding -DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=OFF to the CI CMake invocation or set an env override. That should unbreak consumer builds until we root-cause.

maria: I can push a quick CI change to override the flag for the linux runners and roll the image back in staging if needed. But let's bisect first to see which image layer introduced this behavior.

alex: I'll bisect the image tags now. Which two tags bracket the roll? nina: gcr.io/redwood/toolchain:2026-03-05 (last known good) -> gcr.io/redwood/toolchain:2026-03-10 (broke).

alex: Got it. I'll try to reproduce with both digests and run a narrow bisect. If I can reproduce locally I'll share the minimal repro and open a tracker.

nina: Thanks. If anyone needs a temporary unblock, add -DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=OFF in the CI job or set CXXFLAGS to remove -flto. I'll post logs and the full link-map from the failing binary in an hour.

alex: Confirmed - I can reproduce the duplicate symbol with the 03-10 image inside docker. Starting automated bisect across the intermediate images now — will update here with the bad layer/commit.
